evaluator_anchored_claim: On the Wiki-Squirrel (5,201 nodes, 198,353 edges), WormNet-v3 (16,347 nodes, 762,822 edges), and CA-Netscience (379 nodes, 914 edges) graphs, the proposed PDP_RSC and ADP_RSC algorithms are reported to outperform PDP_Comp and ADP_Comp baselines by 3 to 4 orders of magnitude in accuracy at query-set size Theta(n^2) (Section 5, Experiments).

runtime.query_distribution: i.i.d. uniform over queries producing distinct induced subgraphs
runtime.measurement_stop_rule: relative standard error of average query time below 5%
runtime.theta_n2_total_time: mean query time multiplied by query count plus preprocessing time
runtime.reported_hardware: Intel Xeon Platinum 8562Y at 2.80 GHz with 768 GB RAM
